blocks.text: Bom Jardim, snorkelling and Chapada dos Guimarães

provenance.wordAbsenceReason: The selected Word describes Nobres and Chapada on day 4 and does not contain this Bom Jardim first-day heading; translated the assigned RU route label unchanged.

blocks.text:
An early departure at 07:00 takes you to the village of Bom Jardim, about 162 km from Cuiabá airport, in the transition zone between savanna and Amazon rainforest. The area has many clear rivers, lakes and caves.

On arrival, walk about 1 km to Aquário Encantado and the Salobra River. You will spend about 2 hours in the water, observing fish and underwater vegetation.

After lunch, depart for Chapada dos Guimarães. Along the way, the region’s characteristic rock formations begin to appear; they will be the main focus of the following day. A visit to the town’s historic centre and the Geodesic Marker of South America is then planned. Check in at Park Eco Lodge, followed by dinner and an overnight stay.

Bom Jardim is known for its clear water, which is why the snorkelling session lasts about 2 hours. Before entering the water, the route includes a walk of about 1 km to Aquário Encantado and the Salobra River. Fish and plants are clearly visible in the water, and after the water activity, the journey continues overland to the plateau of Chapada dos Guimarães.
